newsitem.title: TAIWAN: First Bank cuts prime lending rate.
newsitem.headline: First Bank cuts prime lending rate.

text.p: First Commercial Bank, one of Taiwan's Big Three state banks, said on Saturday it was cutting its prime lending rate by 0.025 percentage points to 7.525 percent from 7.550, effective on Monday.
The bank was also cutting its one-month-to-three-year time deposits rates by between 0.10 and 0.20 percentage points, also effective from Monday, a bank statement said.
The Big Three State-run Banks -- Chang Hwa Bank, First Bank and Hua Nan Bank cut their prime lending rates and time deposits rates in early October.
